description_en: Set to `1` to discover custom commands, subagents, and output styles using Node.js file APIs instead of ripgrep. Set this if the bundled ripgrep binary is unavailable or blocked in your environment. Does not affect the Grep or file search tools
description_ja: ripgrepの代わりにNode.jsのファイルAPIを使用してカスタムコマンドやスタイルを探索します。
